C1161.title: Uber Fined €290 Million for Cross-Border Data Transfer Violations
C1161.summary: On August 26, 2024, the Dutch Data Protection Authority (DPA) fined Uber 290 million euros for failing to implement appropriate safeguards for personal data transferred from European Economic Area drivers to the U.S. for over 27 months, violating GDPR cross-border data transfer rules. Uber removed Standard Contractual Clauses with its U.S. parent in August 2021; the transfers breached Article 44 of the GDPR. The case is a wake-up call for compliance risks in cross-border employee data transfers.
